dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Won't you get in trouble if your boss finds out?

dialogues.speaker: Paavo
dialogues.text: Quite the opposite! Drunk customers tend to give off a funky smell, not to mention, they turn violent easily. The last thing we want is bar stools and beer bottles flying around the place!

dialogues.speaker: Paavo
dialogues.text: Good employees like me are always thinking ahead, so we can save the boss some trouble down the line. Wouldn't you agree?
